speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are suffering from severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria. To begin our assessment, can you tell me exactly where the pain is located and does it radiate to your back or groin?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID)

The history of dysuria, burning pain during intercourse, and severe abdominal pain in a sexually active 17-year-old female strongly suggests an ascending infection. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture, and Pelvic Ultrasound.
